captions_note: graphics over the reel's own footage: built with CAPTIONS=0 in a reel, the reel's captions keep running
in_a_reel: CLIPS holds the buyer's own walkthrough video. No video from the buyer = leave the effect out
TITLE and the chapter names are the buyer's own words; no real product's logo or interface
on a medium shot the card sits beside the head, smaller; on a wide shot it sits above the head at full size
steps: put the buyer's walkthrough video in the slot's clips folder and fill TITLE, CHAPTERS and PRESS_WORD in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints the beats and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: clips
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own walkthrough video (mp4 or mov, one video or one per chapter). Only material they may show
